name: booking-schema
description: PostgreSQL 16 booking schema that refuses every conflict itself: no double booking (buffers, multi-resource), travel time between visits, request holds with deadlines, consented notes with retention, hashed manage links. Ships its own law battery.
postMessage:
booking-schema installed in db/booking-schema/.
Install: psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -1 -f db/booking-schema/booking-schema.sql
Prove on a throwaway database: psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f db/booking-schema/battery.sql
Read db/booking-schema/README.md for roles, retention and the write rules.
